claim: Diverse Double-Compiling: two independent toolchains emit byte-identical compiler output
scope: Diversifies BOTH the source-level derivation of the AST (via a C-native, non-rustc parser proven byte-identical to the host) AND the execution of the compiler across two native toolchains (rustc/LLVM vs gcc/non-LLVM). Does NOT prove semantic correctness; it proves no single toolchain hid a divergence across the whole source -> AST -> execution pipeline.
